findings.title: vercel_security_headers
findings.summary: Global nonempty header declarations absent from supplied config: content-security-policy, x-content-type-options. Runtime headers were not measured.
findings.recommendation: Review header policies and measure the approved deployment separately; static absence alone is not proof of runtime vulnerability.

findings.title: vercel_api_routing
findings.summary: An unconditional SPA catch-all precedes any recognized API rewrite in the submitted configuration.
findings.recommendation: Exclude /api and /api/* from the SPA fallback; configure only a separately verified backend origin.

limitations: Static inspection of operator-submitted vercel.json only.
No deployed route, runtime header, external asset ownership or remote provider was verified.
Review records a separate credential holder's human-review attestation; identity is not independently verified.
No payments, network scans or external connector writes.
